title: podstage app icon: a controller
brief: Replace podstage's stage-and-play icon with a console controller: PS4-like, Nintendo-like or generic. Same file feeds the window icon, the desktop entry and the tray.

artboards.title: Generic gamepad on the app tile
artboards.tradeoff: Keeps the tile identity the other podstage surfaces already use, and the silhouette survives its own shadows; the detail is what suffers at tray size.

artboards.title: Bare glyph, console-pad shape
artboards.tradeoff: The most legible at 22 px, which is what a tray icon actually gets; it gives up the tile, so it reads as a glyph rather than as an app.

artboards.title: DualSense: both sticks low, light bar
artboards.tradeoff: The most recognisably PlayStation; the sticks crowd the body, so 22 px turns them into two dark blobs.
